objective: Complete and harden the recovered Phase 5 ROM presence candidate: publish exact local state, consume lifecycle frames atomically, render one safe nonblocking remote avatar, interpolate movement, and emit bounded interactions.
closed_decisions: Keep COOP_NET_BRIDGE_GAME_PROTOCOL_VERSION and the bridge ABI at version 1; the 28-byte LocalPresenceStateV1 replaces the dormant placeholder without a fallback payload.
Wire WorldLocation coordinates are signed map-local values; export subtracts MAP_OFFSET and inbound rendering adds it exactly once using safe signed arithmetic.
Sample at the existing six-frame cadence with independent nonzero wrapping source_sequence, warp_sequence, and outer bridge sequence domains.
Publish OVERWORLD only during safe controllable on-foot overworld state; otherwise publish HIDDEN using the last valid compatible pose with idle movement and animation.
Validate checksum, epoch, outer sequence, message type, exact payload size, and strict presence decoding before reducer mutation; malformed data never mutates runtime state.
Apply pending remote state only in normal CB1_Overworld and never mutate or render cloud remotes in local-link callbacks.
Reserve dynamic ObjectEvent local ID 0xFC, render at most one remote, never evict an NPC, preflight palette capacity, and re-resolve ObjectEvent and sprite ownership before every mutation or removal.
Move logical coordinates authoritatively and interpolate sprite base x/y over exactly six field frames with s32 arithmetic; keep x2/y2 zero and snap on discontinuity or recreation.
Remove stale visuals after 90 field frames, on transport loss, on warp commit, or when local context no longer matches; preserve pending logical state only for bounded safe retry.
Remote objects are nonblocking and centralized lookups skip them as source and target while continuing to find overlapping real objects.
Facing-adjacent remote interaction is consumed before vanilla script lookup and uses explicit NONE, SCRIPT_STARTED, and CONSUMED_NO_LOCK outcomes so send-only and queue-full paths never lock or step.
SESSION_READY remains only the ROM transport/epoch handshake and is not cloud PRESENCE_READY.
ApplyCurrentWarp increments the nonzero local warp sequence after location installation and immediately clears reducer, interpolation, and owned renderer state.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit src/coop/presence.c, test/coop/presence.c, Rust crates, Lua, build scripts, save layouts, maps, graphics assets, local-link or RFU behavior, battle code, documentation, or orchestration artifacts.

Do not bump a protocol or ABI version, serialize engine structs, leak MAP_OFFSET onto the wire, equate sequence domains, accept malformed or wrong-epoch lifecycle data, evict ObjectEvents, trust cached sprite ownership, or allocate unbounded state.
Do not make the remote collide, mask a real overlapping object, fall through to vanilla lookup, return a locking result without a script, or use sprite x2/y2 for interpolation.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, create or remove worktrees, or revert any other worker's edits; preserve the sealed index and all unowned content.

acceptance_criteria.description: The ROM exports region-qualified map-local location and exact 28-byte LocalPresenceStateV1 at 10 Hz with independent source, warp, and bridge sequences and correct last-valid-pose HIDDEN gating.
Spawn, update, and despawn bridge frames are validated atomically; wrong epoch, malformed data, invalid lengths, and invalid sequences never partially mutate presence state.
One remote Brendan or May ObjectEvent is safely spawned, retried, adopted, moved, hidden, and removed without NPC eviction, palette misuse, stale sprite destruction, or local-link behavior changes.
Remote movement reaches exact target base coordinates over six frames, retargets continuously, keeps sprite offsets zero, snaps on discontinuities, and removes stale visuals after 90 frames.
Remote players remain nonblocking and never mask real objects in collision, surfing, Strength, or position lookups.
Facing A emits one exact 20-byte adjacent interaction and is consumed without lock, step, crash, or vanilla fallthrough, including queue-full failure.
Every warp commit increments the nonzero local warp sequence, immediately fences old reducer and renderer state, and applies the engine coordinate offset exactly once.
Focused Cloud Coop tests, modern ROM build, bridge-manifest tests and regeneration, and diff checks pass with production changes confined to the discovery-approved paths.
